children: Motilal Oswal's research report on HPCL

HPCL reported a standalone EBITDA of INR93.7b (est. EBITDA: INR17b), due to lower-than-estimated marketing losses. Reported GRM (excluding the impact of SAED) stood 8% below our estimate at USD32.2/bbl. Blended gross marketing margin (including inventory) stood at negative ~INR0.1/lit (est. negative INR7.2/lit). LPG under-recovery stood at INR36.2b (vs. INR56b in 1Q). Standalone PAT above our est. at INR34.8b.

We estimate the company to deliver RoE of 20.4% in FY28 and a 5.6% FY28E dividend yield. We have not assumed any significant benefit from the start-up of a bottom-upgradation unit and Project Samriddhi. Considering the above factors, we downgrade HPCL to Neutral, with an SoTP-based TP of INR335.
